scope: Public first-party product and technology pages sampled to understand adjacent player promises, access modes, interaction patterns, creator mechanics, and AI-character expectations.

categories.name: Browser virtual pets and persistent worlds
categories.question: How do immediate access, care, collection, customization, and community create recurring value?

categories.name: Systemic and procedural pet simulation
categories.question: How do variation, breeding, behavior, and expressive systems generate personal stories?

categories.name: Creature exploration and restoration adventure
categories.question: How do empathy, discovery, action, and environmental stakes support a complete journey?

categories.name: Large-scale creature-catching RPG
categories.question: Which expectations are set by broad worlds, collection, combat, progression, and distinctive creature abilities?

categories.name: AI characters and companions
categories.question: Which interaction, memory, animation, autonomy, safety, cost, and disclosure expectations are emerging?

references.name: Neopets
observedFacts: The first-party page presents Neopets as an online virtual pet game centered on adoption, customization, interaction, storytelling, collecting, care, and social play.
The classic Neopets experience is presented as playable in a browser.
references.mythicalInference: Browser pet care and world exploration are familiar; Mythical needs to prove why one relationship and a finite adventure create a different reason to begin and return.

references.name: Wobbledogs
observedFacts: The first-party site describes a 3D pet simulation sandbox about raising a hive of mutating, physically simulated dogs.
references.mythicalInference: Systemic mutation is an immediately legible source of surprise and sharing; Mythical should show procedural variation without making absolute uniqueness claims.
unknowns: Whether Mythical's narrative depth improves or distracts from the pet fantasy

references.name: Flock
observedFacts: The publisher describes a multiplayer cooperative game about flight, discovery, nurturing a herd, charming creatures, collection, and sharing with friends.
references.mythicalInference: Creature discovery can be sold through a visually coherent activity and emotional tone; Mythical's equivalent needs equally clear proof of the hatch/bond and restoration actions.
unknowns: Relative importance of collection and relationship

references.name: Creatures of Ava
observedFacts: The studio presents the game as an empathy-led action-adventure and creature-saver experience.
references.mythicalInference: A restoration or saving premise can carry action-adventure stakes without an extraction-first frame; Mythical must make its Earth-versus-living-world tension distinct and concrete.
unknowns: Whether Mythical's Project Beacon premise is understood without explanation

references.name: Whimside
observedFacts: The first-party page positions a low-pressure creature collection companion that occupies part of the screen.
It presents breeding combinations, creature traits, room customization, and a Twitch integration with viewer participation.
references.mythicalInference: Creator compatibility can be a product behavior, not just an outreach channel; Mythical should first prove that its living moments are watchable before considering integration work.
unknowns: Whether active adventure or passive companionship better fits Mythical's intended sessions

references.name: Aniimo
observedFacts: The official site presents a next-generation creature-catching open-world RPG across console, PC, and mobile, with exploration, training, battle, an interactive world, and a Twine mechanic.
references.mythicalInference: Mythical should not compete on content volume or production scale; browser immediacy, one relationship, authored moral tension, and responsible implementation need to be unmistakable alternatives.
unknowns: Player response to scale versus intimacy

references.name: Dobu Labs
observedFacts: The public game page presents a free 3D browser virtual pet with a lab creature, an AI overseer, an escape story, and dialogue that affects the ending.
references.mythicalInference: Browser access plus pet care, AI framing, story, and choice already coexist in a close adjacent proposition; Mythical's differentiation cannot rest on those nouns alone and must be proven through relationship depth, restoration, animation, and execution quality.
unknowns: Depth of choice or companion systems

references.name: Beanlings
observedFacts: The first-party page explicitly targets free browser pet-game discovery and presents creature raising without a download.
references.mythicalInference: Generic browser-pet queries already have focused pages; Mythical needs canonical category language plus stronger proof and story differentiation rather than keyword imitation.

references.name: Sensipets
observedFacts: The first-party page presents a browser-based virtual pet game with worlds, community, and companion genetics or lineage systems.
references.mythicalInference: Genetics is not a sufficient category position by itself; Mythical should connect variation to a visible relationship and authored journey.

references.name: NVIDIA ACE for Games
observedFacts: NVIDIA presents ACE as technology for autonomous game characters and assistants, including characters that plan, act, reflect, converse, guide, and animate.
references.mythicalInference: Broad AI-character language is becoming less differentiating and more expectation-heavy; Mythical should describe exact player-visible memory, agency, animation, limits, and human authorship.
unknowns: Player demand for any specific capability

hypotheses.title: Relationship-plus-journey whitespace
hypotheses.statement: One companion inside a complete browser restoration adventure with moral choice is more distinctive than a collection-first or care-loop-first proposition.
hypotheses.falsifier: Intended adults and players cannot accurately recall relationship, restoration, and choice after authentic proof, or consistently prefer a simpler familiar category promise.

hypotheses.title: Gameplay leads and AI explains
hypotheses.statement: Leading with the playable emotional promise produces better qualified comprehension and trust than leading with AI or procedural technology.
hypotheses.falsifier: Accurate AI-led language materially improves qualified comprehension and play intent without increasing misleading expectations or trust concern.
hypotheses.decisionUse: Homepage message, creator/press framing, and company narrative

hypotheses.title: Adult-controlled discovery first
hypotheses.statement: Adult, guardian, creator, press, partner, and general creature/narrative discovery can reach the intended player without behavioral targeting toward children.
hypotheses.falsifier: Moderated evidence shows the framing is unclear or inaccessible to intended players, or a safer lawful alternative performs materially better.

hypotheses.title: Trust must be inspectable product evidence
hypotheses.statement: Specific local-first, age, data, AI, support, and governance evidence improves adult permission and partner confidence more than a generic safety claim.
hypotheses.falsifier: Guardians and partners cannot find or explain the evidence, or it does not address their material concerns.
hypotheses.decisionUse: Parent/trust pages, partner package, and company story

hypotheses.title: Visible living moments are the acquisition unit
hypotheses.statement: Hatch/bond, restoration, and Project Beacon proof produce stronger qualified comprehension and meaningful play than generic feature lists.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched approved tests show no improvement in qualified comprehension or meaningful play relative to factual text.
hypotheses.decisionUse: Proof priorities, editorial sequence, creator package, and search pages

hypotheses.title: Browser access is leverage only with reliability
hypotheses.statement: No-download and no-account starting access reduces friction only when boot, performance, input, save, audio, and device behavior are reliable.
hypotheses.falsifier: Observed first sessions show browser convenience is not understood or technical friction dominates the proposition.
hypotheses.decisionUse: Release readiness, portal feasibility, and access messaging

watchSignals.signal: Reference-product launch, platform, access, or pricing-model change
watchSignals.action: Recheck the first-party source and reassess only affected inferences.

watchSignals.signal: New companion memory, autonomy, conversation, animation, or AI disclosure claim
watchSignals.action: Record exact language and evidence boundary; do not copy or escalate Mythical claims automatically.

watchSignals.signal: Creator/community mechanic or distribution pattern with observable fit
watchSignals.action: Route a sourced hypothesis to A-007 or A-019 without outreach or integration.

watchSignals.signal: Trust, child-safety, privacy, moderation, or monetization controversy or policy change
watchSignals.action: Escalate to governance and reassess risk; do not exploit the event for marketing.

watchSignals.signal: Accepted Mythical customer evidence contradicts the category position
watchSignals.action: Prioritize customer evidence, record the contradiction, and request a positioning decision.

currentRecommendation.position: Browser creature-raising action-adventure with a living companion and choice-driven science-fiction world.
